configurePresets.name: windows-clang
configurePresets.description: Visual Studio 2026 Insiders Clang 22.1.3 (clang-cl): compiles C++26 and #embed. Uses the MSVC ABI, Windows SDK and vcpkg x64-windows.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: A checked build with clang-cl: asserts on, no optimisation. The profile an IDE should read the code with, since cl cannot configure the project at all.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: The build that ships: optimised across the whole engine, stripped, asserts off.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: The engine as latex.js, latex.wasm and latex.data. Needs EMSDK and VCPKG_ROOT set, and the libraries installed for the wasm32-emscripten triplet: vcpkg install harfbuzz libpng libjpeg-turbo libwebp zlib --triplet wasm32-emscripten
